subject: english
stem: Which sentence reports a fact without evaluation?
options: The cafe stopped using plastic forks in June
Stopping plastic forks was a wonderful choice
Every cafe must do the same

optionRationales.reason: The cafe stopped using plastic forks in June：行動與月份可查且無評價。
Stopping plastic forks was a wonderful choice：wonderful 是評價。
Every cafe must do the same：must 是規範。
June was the perfect time：perfect 是評價。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「陳述能否由可查資料驗證，或包含個人評價與偏好」可推出 The cafe stopped using plastic forks in June；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 The cafe stopped using plastic forks in June 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
